about: Known vulnerabilities accepted for now by scripts/ci/audit-gate.js, each with the reason.
All of these need a major upgrade (NestJS, Prisma, Next.js, Expo SDK) and go when it is done;
CI says when one is fixed so it can be removed. Anything not listed fails CI.
